newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - ANI sells North American container unit.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - ANI sells North American container unit.

text.p: Engineering group Australian National Industries Ltd (ANI) said on Tuesday it was selling 100 percent of its North American unit, Container-Care International, to a group of U.S. investors for about US$18.3 million.

ANI said the investor group comprised Equus II Inc, a U.S. investment group and interests associated with it, who will control 60 percent of the group, and some members of CCI's current management team, who will control the balance.
It was expected that the sale would be completed on or around January 31, 1997.
The sale is subject to the investor group security debt facitilities to fund the working capital requirements of CCI on and from the completion date.

ANI said leasing arrangements which currently exist between ANI and CCI relating to real estate owned by ANI and occupied by CCI will be formalised by way of the execution of 10-year leases between ANI and CCI.
ANI intended to market those properties for sale after completion of the sale of CCI.
ANI had also agreed to convert US2 million in existing intercompany obligations into a five-year subordinated note payable to ANI on arm's length commercial terms.
